items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He’s a screwball but he got a lot of technique.

ctx.x: He’s a screwball but he got a lot of technique. They wanted to put me and him together you know, they had done it with Mary Lou. So I told ‘em, I said, “I’ll steal that show if I have to pull up my dress.”
You mentioned a few of these people being geniuses. What does it take in Dorothy Donegan’s mind to be a genius?
